messages:
ben_partnerships: Quick sync — Datadog asked for a joint marketplace tile + opinionated dashboard for Private GPU deployments. Want to align on what we ship in the tile and what we leave to the SI. cc @alice_dev @carmen_obs :eyes:

alice_dev: I can own the sample app + OTEL collector config. Plan: minimal docker-compose with otel-collector -> datadog otlp exporter + example inference client. Keeps onboarding <10m.

carmen_obs: For dashboard templates: we should include 1) latency P50/P95 per model route, 2) GPU util + memory by node, 3) trace waterfall for cold vs warm KV cache. Also a reroute/fallback error rate chart.

simon_hw: From HW partner side we need GPU topology labels (nvlink, mig) surfaced as resource attributes. Datadog tile should map those to tags so customers can filter by MIG slice. Otherwise SI configs get messy.

alice_dev: draft otel config (very small):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<DD_API_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
use this in sample repo, we'll add env var instructions.

linda_ps: Marketing question — do we have a soft launch date? Datadog wants a screen capture + short blurb by next Tue for their marketplace review. Also confirm embargo window (they asked for 48h).

ben_partnerships: Target: our internal timeline — sample repo + dashboard templates by next Thu, PR for tile metadata by Fri. Can we commit? If yes I'll tell them tentative dates.

carmen_obs: I can finish dashboards by Wed EOD. Will include a JSON export and a lightweight README with recommended widgets and thresholds.

simon_hw: I'll add resource attribute mapping and a small script to tag nodes with nvlink/mig. Should land Wed morning.

alice_dev: I'll push sample repo + README tomorrow afternoon. Need a final list of attributes to include (carmen, ben — send me the list).

ben_partnerships: List: model.route, model.version, gpu.type, gpu.mig, node.region, request.size, kv_cache.hit. + trace/span annotations: warm_cache=true/false, routed_to_fallback=true/false.

linda_ps: I'll draft the marketplace blurb and hold the screenshot until you confirm final dashboard. If embargo required, mark assets as "embargoed" in the docs.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra/telemetry-samples/main -> staging at build #312 :tada:

alice_dev: nice — will smoke test staging sample after deploy, will report back.

ben_partnerships: Ok team, next steps: alice -> sample repo, carmen -> dashboards, simon -> node-tagging script, linda -> blurb + embargo coordination. I'll schedule a 15m sync Tue noon if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
